section_label: Mixtures with Other Herbicides and Plant Protection Agents
notes: Named at [0161] as the substance that may be formulated or applied together with safeners. No amount is stated, so quantity is null. Role is other because the compound is co-formulated here rather than made or consumed; finalise.py lets a later section's populated scalar win, so this value can overwrite the reactant role recorded by the experimental sections. Paragraph [0162] opens with a long list of chemical classes of possible mixing partners, from 1,2,4-thiadiazoles to isoxazolines. Those are class terms with no member named and no compound record is made for any of them; only the specific substances the paragraph then names are emitted. The mineral salt solutions and the non-phytotoxic oils and oil concentrates of [0163] are likewise classes with no member named and are deliberately not emitted.
